limitation_note: Every AERFScorer.score() and AdaptiveAERFUpdater.recompute() call above is the real, unmodified baseline implementation. The claim TEXT for P1/P2/P3 is real, verified corpus content. The support/contradicts LABELS on the claim_pairs (who corroborates/contradicts whom) were supplied by human annotation (ground_truth_claim_pairs.json) rather than by the real NLI model, because this sandbox cannot download NLI model weights (see main report). The 'higher_quality_evidence' and 'new_contradictory_evidence' steps additionally use one hypothetical illustrative claim each (not drawn from the 5-paper corpus) purely to exercise the sequential-evidence-arrival mechanism end to end; this is flagged per-transition above and must not be read as a finding about any real paper.
